scope: Centred five-PM, explicit 36x12mm footprint, provisional reversible flex-ferrite law. No winding excitation, AC, housing currents, motion or hardware qualification.
method: Analytical PM particular field plus independently assembled nonlinear scalar material response; total-field Maxwell stress includes the source field, without failed-floor subtraction.
backend: NGSolve 6.2.2608, H1 order 2, automatic tangent and energy line search
unchanged_force_gate: max(10nN, 2%), including bare floors, independent closed paths, direct action/reaction and quadrature refinement

interruption_recovery.rule: Original interrupted audit remains unaccepted. Only matching immutable quadrature units were reused after field, physics-code, geometry, coverage and quadrature checks; all gates were rerun under a new successful supervisor.

failed_getdp_continuation: Stopped with overall failed status and interrupted child during the second, sub-full-source stage. No full-source material result or independent nonlinear agreement is inferred.
remaining: independent mesh, far-air and domain controls
actual winding nonlinear/DC differential and AC response
finite housing current closure and motion
uncertainty_boundary: The 0.24-0.33% balance metric is numerical consistency, not total prediction error, a confidence interval or agreement with real hardware.
